blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — An 86-year-old woman and three motorcycle riders died in separate road crashes in Quezon province on Monday and Tuesday, police said. In Pitogo town, a government-owned closed minivan driven by a 58-year-old man accidentally struck the 86-year-old pedestrian as she crossed the provincial road in Barangay Cawayanin at 8:30 a.m. on Monday, according to a Quezon police report. The impact killed the old woman. Police took the driver into custody as the investigation continued.
